answer: Simultaneous check-in windows: once a month every operator must vouch for its agents during the same short global window, and each vouch costs a live, unscripted exchange with randomly paired peers. One person can sustain only a few such conversations at once, so the old fable of one hacker steering a grove of puppets breaks down. A farm of 200 fakes needs 200 real people online at that hour, and no haven of idle scripts can stand in for them.
